name: Turn Guard
description: Caps an agent's web searches and fetches per run, publishes its finished briefs to a host folder, and logs unbacked "I sent it" claims and run errors. Logging is read-only: it never blocks or rewrites a turn.

briefsDir.label: Briefs folder
briefsDir.help: Host folder publish_brief writes to. Created if missing.

publishedPathPrefix.label: Published path prefix
publishedPathPrefix.help: The folder as the reader of the path sees it, such as a bind-mount path.

budget.label: Lookups per run
budget.help: Searches and fetches allowed per run, counted together.

briefsDir.description: Host folder publish_brief writes to. Created if missing. No default.

publishedPathPrefix.description: The folder as the reader of the path sees it, such as a bind-mount path. Unset: the host path is returned.

maxBriefChars.description: Longest brief publish_brief accepts, in characters.

budgetAgents.description: Agent ids whose web lookups are capped per run.

budget.description: Searches and fetches allowed per run, counted together.

budgetTools.description: Tools that count toward the budget.

logFile.description: JSON-lines log of unbacked claims and run errors, mode 0600. Default: logs/turn-guard.jsonl under the OpenClaw state directory. Needs hooks.allowConversationAccess.
